title: Roots identification and unit normalization for a supplied pure comparison
statement: Let ell, W, D and quotient-normalized evaluated units eta be as in [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface] and [lem-sfb-diagonal-evaluation-unit], with the canonical Ext structures [lem-sfb-canonical-sheaf-ext]. Put M=G_m^comp, P_n=(Z/ell^(n+1))(1), and kappa_n the compared positive Kummer class [def-sfb-kummer-strict-adjunct-data]. For every supplied strict p-adic system H and isomorphism b:T(M[1])≅H[2], there exist an underlying roots-tower isomorphism roots and p-adic-linear isomorphisms t_n:H_n≅F_n(P_n). They satisfy kummerRootNormalization, and the composite of eta at M[1] with evaluated b, the exact-forgetting shift and single-object comparisons, and t_n with inverse finite-forgetting comparison shifted by two equals negative kappa_n[1] followed by inverse shift addition. No H or b is constructed or asserted to exist.

proof.text: For the supplied comparison b:T(M[1])≅H[2], compute H as the surviving kernel of a common K-flat prime-power reduction. Compare with the constant two-term resolution. Kummer exactness and exact site comparison identify the underlying kernel with roots. The (ell,1) resolution transition induces the actual ell-power roots transition, so these identifications form an isomorphism of towers.

The coefficient action on this kernel factors through the quotient Z/ell^(n+1), and the canonical roots-to-line map is linear for that action. The fixed-scalar versus constant-ring-sheaf equivalence gives finite-level isomorphisms t. Transport the kernel comparisons through H^(-2)(b) inverse, choosing the negative kernel comparison simultaneously at every level. This proves the underlying-map normalization and preserves the transition maps.

On the same resolution the complexes equation of the supplied evaluated unit is the quotient map. The normalized divisible-extension calculation identifies it with the positive Kummer connecting morphism, preceded by comparison on units. Shift once and insert the inverse shift-addition comparison. The negative kernel identification gives the required negative sign. Transport through the supplied b and its induced kernel isomorphisms; no equation is claimed for independent choices of roots and t.

theorem strict_kummer_pure_kernel_normalization (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    (hW : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W))
    (η : ∀ n, DiagonalEvaluationUnit (diagonalForget ℓ W)
      (diagonalScalarAdjunction ℓ W) D n) :
  KummerPureKernelNormalization
    (A := DiagonalAb W) (B := DiagonalMod ℓ W)
    (abA := diagonalAbSheafAbelian W) (abB := diagonalModuleSheafAbelian _ W)
    (hA := kummerAbHasExt W)
    ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W) (diagonalForget ℓ W)
    (diagonalScalarAdjunction ℓ W) D
    (fun n => Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n)))
    (fun n => diagonalFiniteToPadic ℓ n W)
    (fun n => cartierForget (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) W)
    ((comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} W).obj W.gmSheaf)
    (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower W ℓ (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime))
    (fun n => geoCartierLine (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (ℓ ^ (n + 1))
      (cartierResidue_cast ℓ (n + 1)) W)
    (fun n => kummerComparedUnit ℓ W hW n)
    (kummerRootNormalization ℓ W hW)
    (fun n ↦ diagonalFiniteForgetIso ℓ n W) η
